name: space-yz
description: Space YZ — a free, fast, first-person gravity arena shooter for Chrome.

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @space-yz/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @space-yz/server" "npm run dev -w @space-yz/client"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p packages/server
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
